C API for other packages

Source: R/c-api.R
a5_c_api.Rd

Packages that produce or consume cells in compiled code can convert between 64-bit ids and a5_cell vectors through a5R's C API, without depending on how a5_cell stores its data. Add LinkingTo: a5R and Imports: a5R to the package's DESCRIPTION, then include a5R.h:

Details

#include <a5R.h>

// ids to an a5_cell vector; is_na may be NULL
SEXP cells = PROTECT(a5R_cells_from_u64(ids, is_na, n));

// an a5_cell vector to ids and NA flags; returns the length
R_xlen_t n = a5R_cells_to_u64(cells, ids, is_na);

a5R_api_version() returns the version of the API, currently 1, also given by a5_info()$c_api. NA cells are flagged in an int array, as in an R logical vector, rather than encoded in the id. Packages written in Rust can call the same functions through R_GetCCallable("a5R", "a5R_cells_from_u64") and its siblings; the signatures are in system.file("include", "a5R.h", package = "a5R").
